goal: Fixed November DiffV2IR MFT, original RGB-only YOLOX-X+ByteTrack HOTA29.528970687393972; minimum+5 absolute HOTA, stretch+10; select only on complete Dev.
motivation: Complete unchanged-native Dev diagnosis:26 of30 long-gap matched-ID transitions have their previous identity outside the primary pool. Counts are conditional on the old path, not a recovery bound or HOTA forecast.
mechanism: Separately supervised old-template/new-tracklet identity reasoning after actual matching-pool departure. A tracklet may resolve its identity within32 frames after its first public output, changing only current/future IDs. No emitted prefix rewriting, tracker lifetime change, GT or future features at inference.

training.normalization_and_fitting: First75percent of each video only; equal nonempty-video and equal available-class weights. Keep early coefficients for late calibration.
training.calibration: Last25percent only;99th and99.9th percentile of known wrong-edge probabilities, separately for RGB and paired models.
training.optimizer: Six deterministic damped Newton updates, L2=0.001 excluding bias, jitter1e-8, maximum direction norm2.
training.encoder_exposure: Frozen descriptor encoders previously saw these Train identities. Late calibration is not a new heldout-encoder evaluation.

selection: This protocol authorizes Train engineering and fitting only. Register complete-Dev controls, integration, interventions, exact source/model hashes and selection before new Dev. New Test requires a complete-Dev winner frozen before all7 Test sequences. Current short-gap risk coefficients are not reused as archive coefficients.
